person_note: The controlling narrator is Philip Ashley, a participating first-person narrator whose I, me, my, and story-specific we recur across sustained event passages. Three independent scholarly analyses describe the whole novel as Philip's restricted or retrospective first-person narrative, and a further explicit reference source agrees. Apparent contrary first-person material in q00487 and q00525 is Rachel's local speech about Ambrose, while q00490 and other dialogue likewise do not create alternate narration. Several upstream bucket assignments appear imperfect—most notably q00494 is person-unmarked opening narration and q00499 is Philip's reflection despite dialogue labels—but their bucket values were not changed. No source indicates sustained narration in another person, and the only notable limitation is the absence of an accessible sustained authorized web excerpt.
